shadows.name: elev-lift
shadows.purpose: Light theme: everything that floats or overlays: phone tab bar, selection bar, sheets, merge dialog, toasts. Dark: 0 18px 36px -18px rgb(12 8 20 / 0.8).

shadows.name: hairline

shadows.name: cover-tab-edge
shadows.purpose: Keeps pale state tabs at 3:1 on the pale ground.

shadows.name: paper-grain
shadows.value: fixed fractal-noise SVG overlay, opacity 0.035 light / 0.05 dark
shadows.purpose: Paper texture over the whole page, never on a scrolling layer.

shadows.name: wordmark-deboss
shadows.purpose: Hairline deboss under the dark-theme wordmark; none in light.

shadows.name: scrim
shadows.purpose: Backdrop behind modal sheets and dialogs.

motion.name: ease-snappy
motion.purpose: State transitions, press-in, page-tab lift (220ms), toast rise.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Entrances: sheet (0.42s), cover-tab drop (0.5s), highlighter sweep (0.7s), ghost books settling (0.7s, 70ms stagger).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: The one physical response every control shares.

motion.name: reading-room-loops
motion.purpose: The only infinite motion; transform and opacity only.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Static scene stays; nothing waits at a first-frame offset.

narrative.overview:
BookTrap is a well-loved paperback that its reader has marked up: coloured sticky page-tabs, a lime highlighter stroke across a fresh find, pencil notes in the margin. The shelf is a reading list annotated the way BookTok readers annotate books. It rejects both the generic grey list app and the museum-piece dark-academia library: playful, rounded and warm, never solemn.

Light is the default: a washed Honeydew ground with near-white cards and deep-grape ink. The dark theme is a softer night version on deep Vintage Grape, never near-black. Depth is soft and low (hairline inset rules plus a diffuse drop), a faint paper grain sits over everything, and the type does the hierarchy through scale contrast rather than ornament. On wide screens the page sits inside a drawn reading room (arched window, candle on a book stack with a bookworm, hanging lamp, bookcase with ladder) that changes from day to night with the theme.

Density is relaxed and mobile-first: one 1080px column, 44px minimum targets, a floating tab bar on phones and a pill nav in the header on desktop.
keyCharacteristics: Page-tabs are the signature control: filter tabs standing on a teal page edge, and state tabs peeking from every cover's top edge.
Teal is the one colour that means "act"; lime appears only for New.
Young Serif for headlines and book titles, Nunito for every control, Kalam for sparing margin notes.
Pills for anything you press, 20px cards, 14px fields, 5px covers.
Status is never colour alone: every state carries a word or a glyph.
Motion is small and physical: a press-in on tap, a tab dropping onto a cover, a highlighter sweeping in once.

rules.name: The One Action Colour Rule
rules.body: Teal means "act". Nothing decorative wears a teal fill except the page edge and the reading room's flame and leaves.

rules.name: The Reserved Lime Rule
rules.body: Lime is for New and nothing else: highlighter, New chip, New tab, New cover tab. It is the same value in both themes; dark mode shows the resting New tab as a lime outline on the card colour because a lime tint goes olive on grape.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Tab Rule
rules.body: Every tab and state fill (teal, slate, honeydew, lime) carries the same dark ink (on-tab), never white.

rules.name: The Titles-Are-Serif Rule
rules.body: Headlines and book titles are Young Serif; every control, label and number is Nunito. A button is never serif and a book title is never sans.

rules.name: The Micro Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing smaller than 0.75rem carries words; 0.7rem is for a single count in a badge that duplicates an accessible name.

rules.name: The Pencil Rule
rules.body: Kalam is sparing and decorative: a margin note is never the only carrier of something you must read to act, and it is aria-hidden when it duplicates visible text.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Border Rule
rules.body: Containers are outlined with a 1.5px inset shadow, not a CSS border, so the outline never changes the box size. Fields are the exception (a real 1.5px border that turns teal on focus).

dos: **Do** use the semantic role tokens (accent, note, reading, read, surface) in components, never a palette hex.
**Do** pair every status colour with its word or glyph: tab labels, status chips, cover-tab glyphs.
**Do** keep every interactive target at 44px or more, including icon-only buttons and nav pills.
**Do** keep ink dark (on-tab) on every teal, slate, honeydew and lime fill.
**Do** give every entrance and loop a reduced-motion path; entrances are skipped entirely, never left at a first-frame offset.
**Do** keep covers at one 2:3 ratio on a shared baseline, with the bookcloth plate always underneath so a slow cover never leaves a blank.
**Do** keep the dark theme on deep grape (#2b2733) and check both themes for AA contrast.
donts: **Don't** use lime for anything but New.
**Don't** use teal fills for decoration on interface surfaces; teal means act.
**Don't** set controls in Young Serif or book titles in Nunito.
**Don't** put information you need to act on only in Kalam margin notes.
**Don't** use near-black for the dark ground or white text on state fills.
**Don't** square off a pressable control; anything you press is a pill.
**Don't** let the reading room catch pointer events, carry meaning, or animate under reduced motion.
